Current membership tier; no historical tier inference.

q02.title: 服务与现金，是两本账。
q02.question: 司机服务队列和窗口现金收付如何不同？
q02.contract: 按完成时间选服务队列；现金按支付/退款时点选窗口。仅成功派单归属收入，重派不重复记账。里程为里程表差值。
q02.sql:
-- q02: How do driver service cohorts differ from cash collected and refunded in the last 30 days?
-- Synthetic coursework. Bounds [lower, as_of), Asia/Hong_Kong wall time.
SET time_zone = '+08:00';
SET @as_of = COALESCE(@as_of, TIMESTAMP('2025-11-15 12:00:00'));
SET @service_days = COALESCE(@service_days,30);
WITH metrics AS (
 SELECT d.driver_id,d.name driver_name,
 SUM(CASE WHEN e.completed_at>=DATE_SUB(@as_of,INTERVAL @service_days DAY) AND e.completed_at<@as_of THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) completed_orders,
 SUM(CASE WHEN e.completed_at>=DATE_SUB(@as_of,INTERVAL @service_days DAY) AND e.completed_at<@as_of THEN
    CASE WHEN e.payment_time<@as_of THEN e.final_fee ELSE 0 END-CASE WHEN e.refund_time<@as_of THEN e.refund_amount ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) service_cohort_net_paid_asof,
 SUM(CASE WHEN e.completed_at<@as_of AND e.payment_time>=DATE_SUB(@as_of,INTERVAL @service_days DAY) AND e.payment_time<@as_of THEN e.final_fee ELSE 0 END) cash_collected_window,
 SUM(CASE WHEN e.completed_at<@as_of AND e.refund_time>=DATE_SUB(@as_of,INTERVAL @service_days DAY) AND e.refund_time<@as_of THEN e.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) refunds_window,
 SUM(CASE WHEN e.completed_at>=DATE_SUB(@as_of,INTERVAL @service_days DAY) AND e.completed_at<@as_of THEN e.measured_km END) measured_km,
 SUM(CASE WHEN e.completed_at>=DATE_SUB(@as_of,INTERVAL @service_days DAY) AND e.completed_at<@as_of AND e.measured_km IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) missing_km_orders,
 GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN e.completed_at>=DATE_SUB(@as_of,INTERVAL @service_days DAY) AND e.completed_at<@as_of THEN e.order_id END ORDER BY e.order_id) order_ids
 FROM Driver d LEFT JOIN v_order_evidence e ON e.driver_id=d.driver_id GROUP BY d.driver_id,d.name
)
SELECT *, cash_collected_window-refunds_window net_cash_window FROM metrics
ORDER BY completed_orders DESC,service_cohort_net_paid_asof DESC,driver_id;

q04.title: 迟到，需要明确基准。
q04.question: 完成服务中哪些开始时间严格超过宽限？
q04.contract: 实际开始与预约开始比较，超过才纳入。附近派单只显示时间邻近，不能据此断言因果。
q04.sql:
-- q04: Which completed services exceed a lateness grace, and what other starts were nearby?
-- Synthetic coursework. Bounds [lower, as_of), Asia/Hong_Kong wall time.
SET time_zone = '+08:00';
SET @as_of = COALESCE(@as_of, TIMESTAMP('2025-11-15 12:00:00'));
SET @grace_minutes=COALESCE(@grace_minutes,0);
SELECT e.order_id,e.scheduled_start,e.start_time,
 ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,e.scheduled_start,e.start_time)/60,2) late_minutes,
 e.driver_id,d.name driver_name,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.order_id) FROM Assignment a2 WHERE a2.driver_id=e.driver_id AND a2.order_id<>e.order_id
 AND a2.outcome='successful' AND a2.start_time>=DATE_SUB(e.scheduled_start,INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
 AND a2.start_time<=DATE_ADD(e.scheduled_start,INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND a2.start_time<@as_of) other_nearby_orders,
 e.order_id AS order_ids
FROM v_order_evidence e JOIN Driver d ON d.driver_id=e.driver_id
WHERE e.completed_at<@as_of AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,e.scheduled_start,e.start_time)>@grace_minutes*60
ORDER BY e.order_id;

q05.title: 现在知道，不等于当时知道。
q05.question: 评价汇总与重算是否一致？报告时点知道哪些评价？
q05.contract: 当前汇总和 as-of 均值分别呈现；未来评价不泄漏到报告时点。插入、更新、删除触发器及回滚已在 MySQL 9.7.1 合成测试库验证。
q05.sql:
-- q05: Do current rating summaries match recomputation, and which ratings were known at as_of?
-- Synthetic coursework. Bounds [lower, as_of), Asia/Hong_Kong wall time.
SET time_zone = '+08:00';
SET @as_of = COALESCE(@as_of, TIMESTAMP('2025-11-15 12:00:00'));
SELECT d.driver_id,d.name driver_name,d.avg_rating current_summary_avg,d.rating_count current_summary_count,
 ROUND(AVG(r.stars),2) current_recomputed_avg,COUNT(r.rating_id) current_recomputed_count,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.rated_at<@as_of THEN r.stars END),2) asof_avg,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN r.rated_at<@as_of THEN r.rating_id END) asof_rating_count,
 GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN r.rated_at<@as_of THEN a.order_id END ORDER BY a.order_id) order_ids
FROM Driver d LEFT JOIN Assignment a ON a.driver_id=d.driver_id
LEFT JOIN Rating r ON r.assignment_id=a.assignment_id
GROUP BY d.driver_id,d.name,d.avg_rating,d.rating_count ORDER BY d.driver_id;

q06.title: VIP 身份，限于当前。
q06.question: 当前 VIP 客户有哪些已完成订单？
q06.contract: 成员等级没有历史表，不能称作服务当日 VIP。支付状态与净收款根据报告时点判断。
q06.sql:
-- q06: Which completed orders belong to customers currently classified as VIP?
-- Synthetic coursework. Bounds [lower, as_of), Asia/Hong_Kong wall time.
SET time_zone = '+08:00';
SET @as_of = COALESCE(@as_of, TIMESTAMP('2025-11-15 12:00:00'));
SELECT c.name customer_name,e.order_id,e.request_time,e.completed_at,e.pickup_location,e.dropoff_location,e.service_type,
 CASE WHEN e.payment_id IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN e.payment_time IS NULL OR e.payment_time>=@as_of THEN 'pending'
 WHEN e.refund_time<@as_of THEN 'refunded' ELSE 'paid' END payment_state_asof,
 CASE WHEN e.payment_time<@as_of THEN e.final_fee ELSE 0 END-CASE WHEN e.refund_time<@as_of THEN e.refund_amount ELSE 0 END net_paid_asof,
 e.measured_km,e.order_id AS order_ids
FROM Customer c JOIN v_order_evidence e ON e.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.membership_tier='VIP' AND e.completed_at<@as_of ORDER BY e.completed_at DESC,e.order_id DESC;
